fusions.name: Herd Press
fusions.desc: Shoulders outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally nearby (max 24%).

fusions.name: Millstone Chew
fusions.desc: A grinding blow that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Warm Hollow
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Fleece Fold
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
